High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[General Kenobi]] (Virtual Set 9, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 9/Light/General Kenobi.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DWMq6CsFhs_FTMNTuNvXXZfXkzTPK4xY/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>General Kenobi.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,344,020 bytes, SHA-256 <code>a95072f2f3a6801700c32ff5b3a0951e88cdb75d3dce1c3745a0c7fc8f8c642b</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The official published face at [[General Kenobi]] remains [[:File:V9-L-generalkenobi-2018-07-08.gif]]. This attributed print-ready recreation is retained as a qualified comparison rather than an exact same-face High-Res Scan. The official face prints host caption “Return Of A Jedi”; the attributed fan rendition omits it. The official face prints a left-edge image credit that is omitted in the fan rendition. The official face also prints a concept credit that is omitted in the fan rendition. Its file bytes, original TIFF master, provenance, creator attribution and fair-use rationale remain unchanged; this comparison does not establish an additional official publication or errata ordinal.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
